body_health_migration: old saves have MAX_HEALTH base set to 200 and retain their remaining HP percentage; HierophantHealthVersion=2 prevents repeated rescaling
encounter_location: castle roof / Final Plateau sector finale; new castle gazebo places one normal castle-brick pedestal at local (10,0,10) and the Hierophant spawner one block higher at (10,1,10). Native spawn/reset/reward home follows the raised spawner; barrier opening includes the row below it without removing the pedestal. Forge template placement replaces its former Hierophant spawner with air; unrelated spawners remain unchanged. Existing generated castles/spawners are not automatically moved

rising_arena.activation: only open tagged barriers inside the original 21x21x12 roof gazebo; the default tag contains twilightforest:violet_force_field
rising_arena.preserved: keep all normal roof/floor blocks, neighbouring castle sectors, players and the native home point in place; no lift, ascent corridor, dirt shockwave or overhead terrain clearing
rising_arena.home: new encounters retain the original spawner/home position for native peaceful reset, party-wipe reset and loot placement
rising_arena.legacy: completed raised platforms remain untouched. Interrupted legacy journals stop at their already reached integer height, restoring only recorded floor cells into air without clearing paths or overwriting existing blocks. Retain the legacy moving-entity ID for save loading, but loaded visuals have no collision or passenger logic and discard immediately
rising_arena.safety: only inspect loaded chunks; opening has no +20-height requirement. Pending unopened columns resume without forced loading; old passenger metadata is cleared on login without teleporting the player

arena_radius_migration: new stationary encounters retain radius 20 combat bounds; old journals retain their saved radius and already reached height, never resume ascent or expand their floor
native_boss_base: TheTwilightHierophantEntity directly extends twilightforest.entity.boss.BaseTFBoss; skill/animation interfaces no longer require the custom BossEntity superclass
trophy_skin: same head/hood meshes as the living Hierophant; under the hood, use the viewing player's skin like the TF giant camera-player fallback; never the fixed Benimatic texture
shield_capability: twilightforest_finale:hierophant_shield; EntityCapability<IHierophantShield, Void>, provider attached only to the existing Hierophant entity
shield_state_storage: capability owns HP, maximum HP and ten-second damage-polarity clock; saved in HierophantShieldCapability; SynchedEntityData is a client replica; old shields migrate proportionally to the new 200 HP default without healing. Legacy motion fields remain for save compatibility but the rush/stun attacks are no longer selected
intro_pose: after the gazebo barrier opening, stand upright throughout; present the native fortification scepter in main hand and force-field scepter in off hand; gradually form a deep-blue cube, then stow both scepters
shield_visual: native CubeOfAnnihilationModel/Roving Cube texture; side length 2.6 times entity scale, centred on the standing collision box; smooth growth from tick 20 through 80; deep-blue/red tint; no rush/spin; active opacity is max(0.5, shield HP/max HP). The unnamed HP bar displays the real health ratio
shield_break_transition: immediate smoke relocation away from the player, then random phase-two attack

shield_blue_burst.aim: reacquire nearest valid target for each shot; no simultaneous spread; pending shots and next-shot clock are saved

shield_damage_window: throughout phase one after the introduction; no spinning invulnerability or shield-block stun loop
shield_polarity: deep-blue magic-only / red physical-only, switches every 200 combat ticks, never on damage. Wrong damage still reflects with thorns and displays the translated hint. Red missile uses a non-terrain-destroying explosion with ANNIHILATE explosion particles
shield_health_config_key: hierophant.plateauShieldHealth; new key replaces alternatingShieldHealth so legacy 50 HP configs do not mask the 200 HP default
shield_rush_damage: chargeDamage * currentSpeed / 1.25; with default chargeDamage=10 the initial 1.9 speed deals 15.2 damage; speed also scales knockback
weapon_volley: 30 throws alternating actual main/off hands; random knightmetal pickaxe/sword/axe; interval accelerates from 10 to 3 ticks; launch speed 1.6. New HierophantThrownWeapon extends vanilla ThrowableItemProjectile, inheriting snowball gravity 0.03, air drag 0.99 and water drag 0.8; pickaxe damage 3, others 6, TF damage types and smoke impact. Eight-tick follow-through only; no axe-throw finisher
axe_slam: independently selected skill; raise diamond minotaur axe with both hands for 40 ticks (2 seconds), then 20-damage ground shock inside a horizontal radius of 7; jumping or moving out of range avoids the ground hit; native Minoshroom slam damage type/sound; recover through tick 64
ceiling_bricks: phase-two slam retains up to 12 vanilla FallingBlockEntity castle bricks; use real ceilings where present, or virtual air-space twelve blocks above the stationary arena when it has no ceiling. Native falling physics, damage capped at 20; no actual roof removal, block placement or item drops; landing produces brick dust
ice_bomb: native IceBomb entity and damage/zone behaviour; two hands reach behind/overhead, release at tick 30 of 54. Only Hierophant-owned/tagged bombs suppress placing snow, adding snow layers and replacing plants with snow/air; native water/lava freezing, damage, chilling and zone particles remain unchanged
chuckle: 40 ticks, hand covering mouth and bent waist, witch celebration sound, no combat effect; cannot follow itself and is not selected at or below half HP
barrage_projectile_visual: fixed 0.3-block cube centred on the projectile hitbox; age changes rotation only, never size; separate rendering entry point from shield growth
barrage_interruptions: after every relocation choose a fresh random eligible skill; fan/reactive movement no longer forces a barrage resume
beam_damage_config_key: hierophant.phaseTwoBeamDamage; old beamDamage does not override the new phase-two default

summoned_adherent_caps.scope: simultaneously living summons per Hierophant; pending circles reserve remaining slots and unloaded summons retain their UUID reservation

summoned_adherent_target: assign the Hierophant's current target immediately on spawn and keep following that target during AI; ordinary Adherents are unaffected
summoned_adherent_cleanup: kill all loaded owned summons when phase two ends and cancel pending circles. Minion UUIDs are saved; reloaded summons die if the owner has left phase two, or after a 40-tick grace period if their owner is absent. Death/removal releases the slot, chunk unloading does not
reactive_movement: accepted body damage requests relocation unless charging the legacy inactive beam or already relocating. A visible close player within 3.5 blocks interrupts ANY second-phase skill, including relocation and axe-slam charging, for a real Peacock Feather Fan gust then relocation; exceptions are the harmless chuckle and a gust already in progress
adherent_friendship: all Adherents and the Hierophant are mutual allies; Adherent.setTarget rejects the Hierophant, casting goals reject allies, existing homing shards ignore allies, and friendly damage is rejected in both directions
held_prop_animation: fan sweep and intro wand presentation follow the entity's actual main arm, matching vanilla ItemInHandLayer; left-handed sweeps are mirrored
beam_implementation: TF Spell Pack ParticleDarkBeam rendering: three square tubes, opaque black core, half-colour shell alpha 0.65 and outer shell alpha 0.3; outer half-width 0.4; four ticks; quadratic width falloff; standard alpha blending, no texture; no Wizardry dependency. Longer charge deepens the crouch with historical afterimages; an eight-tick stand-up thrust precedes the shot; continuously faces/aims at the player until firing
movement: choose a reachable destination that maximizes distance from the nearest valid arena player, always farther than the starting position; reject corridors that cut closer through players. Colliding smoke flight along a loaded, checked corridor, within saved arena bounds; no teleport or forced chunk loading
arena: stationary 20-block-radius combat circle on the original roof; movement remains clamped to the arena. Remove only the gazebo's tagged barriers, never lift the floor or relocate new homes by +20; legacy arenas retain their saved radius/current height
afterimages: phase three only: relocated VzlingLib 0.98.8 Shadow record and ExampleMobEntityRenderer historical-pose replay; actual past position, rotation and complete bone transforms; no orbital offsets or repeated live entity renders. Phase two no longer grows blur/afterimages as health drops
phase_three_transition: phase-two lethal body subtraction restores full 200 HP without calling die/postmortem or rolling loot; break/orbit one visual glass heart, rise slowly while invulnerable, draw a visual fiery sword along an arc from outside the arena, catch at tick 110 with WITHER_SPAWN; resume combat at tick 140. Transition and phase are serialized

phase_three_attacks.meteors: jump/hover with subtle vertical bob and one-handed overhead fiery sword; four sequential native HydraMortar-model/texture meteors, one every twenty ticks, appear three blocks above an arena player's head and explode on impact without destroying the arena floor; descend and relocate
phase_three_attacks.fiery_quake: twelve-tick single-knee planting animation with articulated six-pixel thighs/shins: main-side knee down, other foot forward on the floor, both hands on the vertical fiery sword; hold insertion for five seconds. Horizontal shocks one/three seconds after insertion have radii 10/15. After the first shock, smoothly lower the hips and press the sword deeper over eight ticks while keeping the knee/forward foot at floor level. Item placement samples the blended hands and bypasses native third-person sprite rotation. Lava, actual floor block dust/break sounds but no block deletion
phase_three_attacks.fiery_thrust: relocate to one of the four diagonal outer sectors of the circular arena; hold sword to chest twenty ticks, then a forward thrust with fire/afterimages, igniting and knocking back each struck target once

animation_blending: smoothstep pose entry/recovery/release; per-entity six-tick historical-pose crossfade on action changes; shared authoritative action durations; locally extrapolated metadata clock (held only while barriers await loaded chunks); standing first-phase pacing retains leg animation while the casting arm faces the target
death: only phase three reaches native BaseTFBoss death/removal/loot workflow: curl up, abruptly spread all limbs at tick 40 with ENDERMAN_SCREAM, then dissolve into smoke/ash rather than kneeling. After native chest deposit, one cluster of 48 native-colour totem glitter particles flies from the body to the actual native reward chest over 40-80 ticks: three rotating groups orbit the travelling arched centre, converge at the chest and fade for 12 ticks. Spawn particles at the body only, never along the whole route at once; client-side motion finishes independently of the removed boss. No extra chest/loot roll
loot_safety: inherited BaseTFBoss die/postmortem/postRemoval/shouldDropLoot, native inventory serialization, native chest-or-item setting; no custom capture/reroll/chest placement code; migrates old saved HierophantRewards
loot_layout: entirely inherited BaseTFBoss and IBossLootBuffer; respects doMobLoot and TFConfig.bossDropChests
new_spawner: twilightforest_finale:twilight_hierophant_boss_spawner; native BossSpawnerBlockEntity, roof placement in newly generated castles, summons the 200 HP three-phase Hierophant and removes itself. No ascent-related build-height rejection or home relocation. Already-placed spawners in existing saves are not globally migrated
despawn_behavior: inherited native peaceful reset/home/loot behavior; ten seconds without a living noncreative arena player calls native placeSpawner at the stationary home and discards the boss. No lift restarts, player carrying or upward rejoin teleport
